_about: Single source of truth for the Glass desktop look. Every toolkit theme (Qt style + colour scheme, KWin decoration, GTK3, GTK4/libadwaita, shell QML) is GENERATED from this file. Change a value here, regenerate, and everything moves together.
_accent: The desktop's ACCENT is not a token here: it lives in the shell config (`accent`), set by a colour theme (`themes`: {name: {accent, dark, light}}) or derived from the wallpaper by `glass-mode theme wallpaper [FILE]` (tools/palette.py, the same maths as the shell's own Palette in sirca-shell/src/palette.cpp: the picture's strongest colour family in OKLab, chroma lifted into 0.10-0.20, lightness ~0.62, so it reads on dark and on light glass). The `accent` keys below are the NEUTRAL near-white / near-black the toolkit themes use (the desktop is monochrome by design); the colour reaches other apps only through what glass-mode derives from it: the terminal palette, folder colour, Spotify, fastfetch.

glass._tintAppLight: white reads much heavier than dark smoke at the same opacity: light chrome needs far less of it (onur 2026-09-19)
glass._contentOpacity: effective opacity of content surfaces inside frosted windows

decoration._shadowSize: the SIZE must be the same in both modes: it changes every window's outer geometry, and the global cross-fade (KWin blend changes) stretches the old snapshot to the new geometry: the old look visibly expanded while it faded (onur 2026-09-20). Light mode gets its weight from the strength alone
decoration._shadow: window shadow (0..255 strength). A black shadow that is plenty on a dark desktop all but disappears on a light wallpaper with light windows: light mode gets a much stronger and larger one (onur 2026-09-20)

_decisions.2026-09-18: Variant B chosen by onur: frosted title bars, sidebars, toolbars and dialogs (glass.tintApp + blur); content areas stay solid.
_decisions.2026-09-18b: Palette pulled toward the shell's glass (onur: 'make the theme color fit our dock and top bar more'): neutral near-black instead of blue-grey, chrome 62 % instead of 72 %.
